title: apps/alerting startup wiring: registry -> app.New -> validators/mutators
answers: How does control flow from server startup into apps/alerting rules validation?
Where is the AlertRule/RecordingRule app wired into the apiserver?
What is the entry point for apps/alerting/rules?
body: Server startup: pkg/registry/apps/apps.go wires alertingNotificationAppInstaller/rules installer -> pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go:RegisterAppInstaller builds a rulesAppConfig.RuntimeConfig (closures over legacy ngalert services) and calls simple.NewAppProvider(rulesManifest.LocalManifest(), appSpecificConfig, rulesApp.New). That calls apps/alerting/rules/pkg/app/app.go:New, which iterates apis.GetKinds() and per-kind attaches a validator (buildKindValidator) and mutator (buildKindMutator), registers custom routes (buildSearchRoutes), then simple.NewApp + a.ValidateManifest. Notifications follow the same pattern via apps/alerting/notifications/pkg/app/app.go:New from pkg/registry/apps/alerting/notifications/register.go. Per-request writes hit this Validator/Mutator (e.g. apps/alerting/rules/pkg/app/alertrule/validator.go:ValidateWrite, mutator.go:NewMutator) before storage.
